عَضَدٌ A certain disease in the أَعْضَاد [or arms (pl. of عَضُدٌ)] of camels, (S, O, K,) on account of which they are slit [in those parts]. (S, O.) ＝
-A2- And (tropical:) What is cut, or lopped, of trees; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ عَضِيدٌ (TA) and ↓ مَعْضُودٌ : (S, O:) or العَضَدُ signifies what is cut, or lopped, from trees; or the leaves that are made to fall by beating trees, and used as food for camels: as also ↓ عَضِيدٌ : (TA:) or the leaves scattered off from a tree for camels. (Th, TA.) ＝
-A3- See also عَضُدٌ, first sentence: ―
-b2- and again, near the middle, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
